angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 612,809 km at 31.91 pc = 0.26 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 31.3356 +/- 0.0262 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 31.91 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.881 (0.863 to 0.899) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 612,809 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.865 (0.825 to 0.905) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5333 +/- 2.9 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3650718804281798912: teff_gspphot 5332.535 K (16th-84th percentiles 5329.807-5335.5776), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3650718804281798912: teff_gspphot 5332.535 K (16th-84th percentiles 5329.807-5335.5776), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/monch.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.485, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 130322 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 V, from Paredes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..176P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 130322 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.02 dex, from Wittenmyer et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJS..182...97W/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 130322 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.23544, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 130322 (pscomppars): age 0.35 Gyr, from Udry et al. 2000 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2000A&A...356..590U/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 130322 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.5 km/s, from Hinkel et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...803....8H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
